ios.desc:
Doc Hero – PDF Editor & Sign PDF

Edit, sign, and manage PDF documents with ease using Doc Hero. Whether you need to fill out forms, add signatures, edit text, merge files, or convert images to PDF, Doc Hero gives you all the essential PDF tools in one simple app.

Perfect for students, professionals, business owners, and anyone who works with documents on the go.

Edit PDF Documents

Make quick changes to your PDF files anytime.
• Add text to PDFs
• Edit existing text
• Highlight important content
• Annotate and mark up documents
• Fill PDF forms easily

Sign PDF Documents

Sign documents in seconds with a professional e-signature experience.
• Draw your signature with your finger
• Create stylish typed signatures
• Place signatures anywhere in a PDF
• Resize and reposition signatures
• Sign contracts, agreements, and forms

Designed to be simple, reliable, and efficient.
• Clean and intuitive interface
• High-quality PDF export
• Quick document sharing
• Works offline for most features

Why Choose Doc Hero?

• Powerful PDF editor
• Easy electronic signatures
• PDF signer and document signer
• Fast performance
• No complicated workflow
